t: ShankhNaad user guide.
Talk menu: Chat.
Chat is where you message one person or a whole group, share files, and start calls.
In this video, you will learn how to find a chat, send messages and files, react and reply, start a group, and call from a chat.
To open this page, click Chat in the left menu.
The page has three parts.
On the left are your chats: pinned chats first, then your chats and groups, then teammates you have not messaged yet.
In the middle is the open conversation, with its buttons along the top.
On the right are the details: members, shared files, and storage.
To find a chat, type a name in the search box.
The list filters as you type. Click a chat to open it.
To send a message, click the box at the bottom and type.
Press Enter to send. To start a new line, press Shift and Enter.
To share a file, click the paper clip, drag a file in, or paste it.
Click the smiley for emoji, or GIF to send a moving picture.
Point at a message to see its buttons.
Click an emoji to react. Everyone can see who reacted.
Click Reply to answer one message. Your reply shows the message you answered.
Click the quote in a reply to jump back to the original message.
A message can also be forwarded, marked as a decision or action item, or translated.
Your own messages can be edited or deleted.
To start a group chat, press the plus button.
Give the group a name, and pick the people to add.
Then press Create group. The new group appears in your list.
To talk, press Call, or Video call to start with your camera on. In a group, everyone in it is called.
Press Pin to keep a chat at the top of your list. Press it again to unpin.
Press Details to hide the panel on the right. Press it again to bring it back.
That completes the Chat page.
